comment: Shared conformance fixture definitions. Every SDK conformance lane (TS here, xunit in Verdocs.Sdk, pytest in verdocs-python) runs these same cases against live beta: call the endpoint with raw HTTP and with the SDK, normalize volatile fields, compare status, shape, and data. Env vars: VERDOCS_API_BASE, VERDOCS_TEST_EMAIL, VERDOCS_TEST_PASSWORD from hub/.env.

cases.note: The raw response is an array; the SDK returns the entry with current=true. Lanes compare the SDK result to that entry.

frozen.note: Star toggle is server-broken (400 for every client) and frozen pending Monday retirement discussion. The TS lane asserts curl/SDK equivalence only. New lanes skip it entirely.
